epics.title: Resolve Self-Falsification Cycle Findings
epics.jtbd: When a self-falsification audit identifies unresolved findings, I want the root causes to be fixed directly, so that the container starts and the CI pipeline passes without inventing adjacent scope.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: 100% of confirmed findings resolved without introducing new CI failures
requirements: R1: Fix authenticated requests that incorrectly reject with HTTP 401 on endpoints requiring 200/201 responses

slices.title: Patch API Authentication 401 Rejections
slices.jtbd: When implementing the 401 rejection fix for this epic, I want to patch the authentication code directly, so that the API accepts authorized requests and CI passes.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an authenticated request to an endpoint expected to return 200/201
When the request is processed
Then it must not be incorrectly rejected with a 401 Unauthorized status
Given the authentication logic is updated
When tests are run
Then all CI pipeline tests must pass.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 0 HTTP 401 errors for valid authenticated requests
